$comment: PROVENANCE (issue #591): the canonical Owlpost send-email request schema lives in the private repository Owlpost-to/backend:crates/owlpost-core, which is unreachable from this repository (raw.githubusercontent.com and api.github.com both 404 for it). This fixture is therefore AUTHORED FROM THE RESEND-COMPATIBLE SHAPE Owlpost documents and speaks, not copied from upstream. Refresh it against a real checkout with scripts/refresh-fixture.sh <path-to-Owlpost-to/backend>; that script overwrites this file with the upstream one and records the source commit in this comment.
title: Owlpost send email request
description: POST {base}/v1/emails. Resend-compatible: the same fields Resend accepts, an {id} response.

to.description: Recipient. Owlpost takes a single address, like Resend's string form.

headers.description: Extra RFC 5322 headers as a name -> value object. Order is preserved on the wire so List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post stay paired (RFC 8058).

tags.description: Resend-compatible tags: {name, value} objects whose fields hold only ASCII letters, digits, '_' or '-'.
